fidelity: F2a — Otto/Miller Cycle Thermodynamics + Engine-Block Thermal ODE
source: Heywood (1988) Internal Combustion Engine Fundamentals, McGraw-Hill; US EPA CHP Catalog (2017) Sec.2; Jenbacher J320/J420 & Caterpillar G3500 product data

unit.name: Generic 1 MW Lean-Burn Natural Gas Reciprocating Engine Genset

compression_ratio.note: Geometric compression ratio (lean-burn SI gas engine)
compression_ratio.source: Heywood 1988 Table; lean-burn gas engines r=11-14

gamma.note: Effective ratio of specific heats for combustion products (mean over cycle)

afr_stoich.note: Stoichiometric air-fuel ratio for natural gas (CH4 ~17.2, NG blend ~16)

combustion_efficiency.note: Fraction of fuel chemical energy released in combustion

f_miller.note: Miller-cycle effective expansion factor (early intake valve closing, <1 reduces effective compression)

fmep_a_kpa.note: FMEP constant (rubbing+auxiliary) term, Chen-Flynn/Heywood friction correlation
fmep_a_kpa.source: Heywood 1988 Sec.13.4, large SI engine FMEP 0.1-0.2 bar constant

fmep_c_kpa_per_bar.note: FMEP load term proportional to indicated mep (peak-pressure contribution)

LHV_gas_mjkg.note: Lower heating value of natural gas (CH4 ~50.0)
LHV_gas_mjkg.source: Heywood 1988 Table D.4, CH4 LHV=50.0 MJ/kg

rho_gas_kgm3.note: Density of natural gas (CH4) at STP

rho_air_kgm3.note: Density of intake air at 25C, 1 atm

cp_gas_jkgk.note: Mean cp of combustion products / charge
cp_gas_jkgk.source: Heywood 1988 App.B, burned gas cp ~1.25-1.35 kJ/kgK

cp_block_jkgk.note: Effective specific heat of cast-iron block + coolant

hA_cool_wk.source: Sized so block reaches ~363K at rated load

frac_heat_to_block.note: Fraction of fuel energy rejected to engine-block coolant path
